title: Cadre MCP contract
rules: Use only the single next call returned by a packet.
Use cadre_read only for returned resource URIs.

sections.heading: Public tools
sections.body: `cadre_workflow` starts or continues workflows. `cadre_action` runs namespaced actions returned by packets. `cadre_read` reads one targeted resource.

sections.heading: Envelope
sections.body: Workflow responses expose phase, decision, required inputs, at most one deterministic next call, artifact descriptors, relevant resources, warnings, and errors.

sections.heading: Ownership
sections.body: Cadre packets own control-plane, provider, worker, approval, merge, and generated projection state.
